_comment: Regression gate, not a perf target. Total homepage budget is 2 MB. Cloudflare edge serves each asset in parallel from the nearest POP, and fonts are cached hard on second hit. Three runs with optimistic aggregation: headless Chrome on shared runners sporadically mis-captures the frame trace and reports a multi-second Speed Index against a sub-second FCP, zeroing that audit and sinking the category score below the gate. A single run has no defense against one glitched trace; best-of-three fails only when every run is bad, which is what a real regression looks like.

collect.startServerCommand: bun run build && bun x wrangler dev --local --port 8787
